scope: Fixed 40-episode suite with cooperative markers, simple Blender imagery, and a 30 m M2 handoff; not a population reliability estimate, natural-feature perception, or contact validation; lidar is a ray-cast flash-lidar model with lidar-only retroreflectors, not a measured sensor

performance.scope: Wall times on an unisolated desktop; renderer timing includes PNG writes; RSS sampled every 0.1 s, not OS high-water memory
